best_for: Home-lab owners and admins with many servers who want a tidy host list, and who would pay for Pro the day they need sync.

points.title: Free covers a lot
points.text: The free Starter plan is listed as usable commercially and includes a local vault, SSH and SFTP, AI-assisted autocomplete and port forwarding. Hosts stay on the one device.

points.title: Sync is the paid line
points.text: Cross-device sync, a personal cloud vault, session logs and snippet automation start at Pro, listed at USD 10 per month when billed yearly. Team is USD 20 per seat and Business USD 30, with SAML single sign-on as an add-on. Prices were read on the date below.

points.title: An account is optional
points.text: You can run it without an account by logging out and keeping everything local. Encrypted sync needs both an account and a subscription, and new accounts get a trial of the paid tiers.

points.title: If Pro lapses
points.text: Pro features, including sync, switch off, and your data stays on the device. Logging out while changes are unsynced loses them, so sync before you sign out.

points.title: Students
points.text: The docs say Pro and Team are free through the GitHub Student Developer Pack.

points.title: Linux: the .deb is the official route
points.text: Termius's download guide offers a .deb for Linux. A Snap build cannot reach the local terminal or local files in SFTP. The Flatpak listed here is a Flathub build that Flathub does not mark as verified.

points.title: Windows install is per-user
points.text: The Windows installer installs for the current user, in 32-bit and 64-bit builds, which suits machines where you lack administrator rights.
